prepared.label: Prepared
prepared.description: The sensor is registered but not yet activated.

offline.label: Offline
offline.description: The sensor unit has a problem and needs maintenance.

online.label: Online
online.description: The sensor unit can send data.

active.label: On a run
active.description: The vehicle is assigned to a watering plan that is currently running.

active.label: Active
active.description: The watering plan is active and is currently being carried out.

canceled.label: Canceled
canceled.description: The watering plan was canceled and was not completed.

finished.label: Finished
finished.description: The watering plan was completed successfully.

not_completed.label: Not carried out
not_completed.description: The watering plan was not carried out.

planned.label: Planned
planned.description: The watering plan is planned and can be started.

ok.label: Data plausible
ok.description: The most recently received readings are within the expected range.

flagged.label: Some values discarded
flagged.description: Some readings were implausible and were excluded from the evaluation. The watering status is based on the remaining values.

suspect.label: Check data quality
suspect.description: Several transmissions in a row contained no usable reading. The sensor may be defective and the displayed watering status may be outdated.

reasons.implausible_jump: Implausible jump from the previous value
